newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain has little scope to cut - wise men.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain has little scope to cut - wise men.

text.p: The Bank of Spain is left with very little scope for further reductions in its key money market rate, one of Spain's wise men said on Wednesday.
"There is now a very little scope to cut interest rate," said Angel Laborda, when asked about the monetary policy at a news conference where they presented their latest forecasts.
The key money rate is currently at 5.25 percent.
Laborda forms part of them group of economists who advise the Economy Ministry.
